hooks.prompt:
A Kotlin file was just written or edited. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

Extract tool_input.file_path from the JSON. Use the kotlin-code-reviewer subagent (subagent_type: 'kotlin-code-reviewer') to review that file. Report any convention violations found. If none, confirm it passed.

A SQL file was just written or edited. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

Extract tool_input.file_path from the JSON. Use the db-reviewer subagent (subagent_type: 'db-reviewer') to review that file against the spec and for SQL quality. Report any issues found. If none, confirm it passed.
